_readme: Config for scripts/create-real-account.mjs — a REAL test account for a dev-mode
Every FILL_ME must be replaced. The script refuses to run otherwise, on purpose:
the point of verified facts is that they are TRUE. A fact you didn't check is
worse than no fact — the generator will state it on a page as if it were.
domain MUST be real and resolvable: in dev mode Diagnosis actually fetches it
(mock mode uses a fixture site instead). Prefer a content-rich marketing site;
a JS-only SPA renders empty to the plain HTTP fetcher and will look 'broken'.
COST: a scan costs (prompts x repeats) grounded Gemini calls for measurement,
the same number of cheap parse calls, plus 1 generation. repeats defaults to 5
(config/monitor.yaml). So 3 prompts = ~31 calls. Keep prompts few for a first run.

prompts.text: FILL_ME: a question a real buyer would type, e.g. 'best X for Y'
FILL_ME: an alternatives question, e.g. 'top alternatives to <competitor>'

verifiedFacts.source: FILL_ME: url you checked this on

value.display: FILL_ME: the competitor's REAL published starting price

verifiedFacts.source: FILL_ME: competitor pricing page url you actually read
